1934, January
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 166 Cont. 1934 Jan. Roy Sheney - 45 - going blind
Ed. Kineman - 21 - away - unheard from since September 4th.
Page 167
Jan. Theodore Martin - 38 - student ...
Alfred Kunnas - 18 - fell when small ...? to communion once since confirmed ...
Mrs. M. Byrne - 55 - blood clot threatened - very serious. ... Marg. Duby - 30 - has four small child. - like paralysed - can hardly walk.
Mrs. Woods - 75 - creeping paralysis.
Jan 4th Howard Jno Macey - 10 - losing sight for five weeks. Had left school & Dr. Brown was baffled - could do nothing. Boy was taken to Monastery and enrolled last Tuesday. Before starting home was O.K. Went back to school yesterday.
Geo Gaynor - 27 - student losing learning.
James Hendrick - 57 - non Cath. - heart and kidney trouble ...
5 th Grt. Grand-Ma Mary Brandt - 93 - 92 yrs. in An Detroit - 92 days coming across, has good memory, great faith, still says the prayers her mother taught her ... was 10 when mother + The devil seems jealous of her peacefully praying the rosary.
5th Fr. McClaray says Mass again - writes me of great improvement .. . Thanks for prayers.
Page 168 Jan. 5th Hilliard King - 33 - Presbiterian - wife methodist - eyeritis, en- rolled, promises to be earnest in looking up religion if helped. 6 Cath neighbor phones: "Mr. K. slept all night - very little pain this a.m .... 8 phones himself "No pain since at monastery: Dr. say "no hospital"
Wm. Demery - 34 - drinking - drinking - drinking - good man other- wise .... enrolled perpetually at 3p.m.
7 Mrs. Jos. McDonald Freser - 55 - Scotch Prespt'n of England - mental trouble feared Husband once Catholic, son anxious.
